patch_description: Add a deterministic active-set-style coordinate polishing phase after annealing. The annealer is effective at finding the broad combinatorial structure, but its final proposals still accept thermal regressions and therefore often leave avoidable slack in the smallest determinant constraints. The added phase performs strictly improving maximin moves in barycentric coordinates, trying several local perturbations for each non-vertex point at progressively smaller radii. Comparisons are lexicographic: normalized minimum area is never sacrificed, while the existing tail merit breaks ties and helps avoid immediately recreating another nearly-degenerate triangle.
